annotations.title: Watch an MCP server's listings daily

description: Call this after launching an MCP server or paid agent API to keep it findable: we run launch_check today and every day for 30 days, and tell your webhook (signed) when something changes: the server stops answering, the registry listing falls behind a release, a directory drops it, robots.txt starts blocking. $3 per 30 days; call again with watch_id to renew. Returns today's full launch check.

url.description: The MCP server's public https:// endpoint to watch.

watch_id.description: To renew: an existing watch_id (adds 30 days).

webhook.description: Optional public https:// URL: we POST a signed listing.changed event when something changes.

name: watch_listing
title: Watch an MCP server's listings daily
